items.claim: Michael has grappling holes that were recently exploited when he was taken down and submitted by Jonathan Micallef.
items.quote: those holes were just recently exploited against Jonathan Micallef, where he was clearly the better striker, but he got taken down and submitted.

items.claim: Oban's recent losses are specifically from opponents who were able to take him down.
items.quote: His losses are from people who are able to take him down.

items.claim: Oliveira brings speed, power, volume, and pressure that will be too much for Elliott.
items.quote: Oliveira will look to come in with speed and power and volume... I do expect that the insane volume and the pressure from Oliveira is going to be too much for Elliott.
